subject: Large effect size range in latent trait GWAS

messages.author: e2f51e03f70d5d25
messages.subject: Large effect size range in latent trait GWAS
parts:
Hi,

After a GWAS-by-subtraction, I saw that the effect estimate ranges from -1 to +1 and have become suspicious of this. For comparison with Demange et al, it is the "noncog" GWAS (residual phenotype) that is provided this -1 - +1 est range.

What causes this large range? What should I check for that could be causing this? It is worth noting that there are very small proportions of variants (approx. 0%, eg ranging 6 - 300) are in these extremes, are they just outliers or is this an indication of something being wrong with my analysis?

Best wishes,
Aoife
